positive.r1_salute_default: The anthropomorphic cat soldier quickly raises her right paw to the brim of her helmet in a crisp military salute and holds the salute firmly; her chin lifts and she stares straight into the camera; her red neckerchief flutters strongly in the wind. Fixed camera, medium shot, same face, fur pattern and US Army uniform as the first frame.
positive.r4_head_turn: The anthropomorphic cat soldier snaps her head up and turns to stare directly into the camera, ears perking forward; strong wind whips her red neckerchief and blows dust across the frame. Fixed camera, medium close-up, same face, fur pattern and US Army uniform as the first frame.
